components.explanation: Three scored capability requirements. One partial at 0.7, one partial at 0.5, one unevidenced at 0. asm_vendor_mgmt is implicit and excluded.
Azure satisfied, Terraform unsatisfied. Terraform is preferred, not must-have, and its absence is reported here rather than being quietly discounted.
Healthcare overlap. Binary axis: any overlap scores full.
Posting seniority architecture-ownership; current position pos_m2 is architecture-ownership. Same enum, graded match, exact.
Scored from the group verdict, not from its members: gas_qualification is satisfied via the postgraduate arm. Summing the members instead would score this 0.66 and be wrong.

aggregate.formula: sum(weight x normalized) / sum(weight) over components_included = (3x0.5 + 2x0.5 + 2x1 + 2x1 + 3x1) / 12 = 9.5 / 12 = 0.792, rounded to 2dp

methods.reliability: Deterministic vocabulary and date arithmetic over two conformance Level 2 documents. Reliable where both sides use the same vocabulary term and silent where they do not - which is the failure mode asm_data_sovereignty demonstrates.

Used only where vocabulary matching fails and a judgement is needed. Published accuracy for linking vacancy text to a skills taxonomy is under 0.40 at rank 1, and general-purpose LLMs underperform supervised extractors on that task, so every verdict from this method carries needs-verification and a confidence below the rule-derived ones.
The only method that can move an assertion to confirmed on a judgement call.

overrides.reason: The matcher scored TOGAF as absent and stopped. The posting says 'or equivalent architecture certification', and the Azure Solutions Architect Expert credential is one. Kept as an override rather than folded in, so it stays visible that a person made this call and not the pipeline.
